thread.title: Rep. Keith Self calls for Senate action on DHS funding and highlights Dallas arrest

author: T. R. James
title: Rep. Keith Self calls for Senate action on DHS funding and highlights Dallas arrest
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives, posted several messages on his official X account at the end of March 2026, addressing issues related to Department of Homeland Security (DHS) funding and law enforcement actions in Texas.
On March 31, 2026, Rep. Self urged members of the Senate to return to Washington, D.C., and address pending legislation: “My message to the Senate: Get back to DC and take up the House’s bill to FULLY fund ALL of DHS—including ICE and Border Patrol. You shouldn’t be on vacation while our Department of Homeland Security remains only partially funded!”
Earlier that day, he highlighted an arrest in Dallas: “ARRESTED: Jose Ramierz, convicted of domestic violence, assault, and burglary, was taken into custody in Dallas, TX. Thanks to @ICEgov’s decisive actions, North Texans are safer.”
On March 30, 2026, Rep. Self also shared a post without additional commentary: https://t.co/yne83mCKoi
Rep. Keith Self has represented his district since winning election in 2022 and securing re-election in 2024. In both races he defeated Sandeep Srivastava—receiving approximately 60.5% of the vote in 2022 and increasing his margin to about 62.5% in 2024.
The current discussion around DHS funding comes amid ongoing debates over border security measures and appropriations for agencies such as Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Border Patrol.
